      "snippet": "Short answer: no — the metaphor did not officially change.
But something did drift, and it’s important to name it precisely.

What did not change

“OS” is still the correct primary metaphor

MetaBlooms is still conceived as:

A core

With governance

Execution rules

Modules / engines

Boot logic

State

Persistence

Nothing today replaced OS with “framework,” “library,” “prompt,” or “tool”

So if you’re asking:

“Did we decide MetaBlooms is no longer an OS?”

No. A
